summary.text: Troy Hebert is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 31, which covers Lafayette and Vermilion parishes, and was first elected in 2023. His official House page lists him on the Insurance, Judiciary and Ways and Means committees.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Hebert's occupation as real estate managing broker.
It lists his education as a degree in environmental and sustainable resources and a Master of Business Administration, both from the University of Louisiana at Lafayette.

sources.title: Troy Jude Hebert, District 31 (Louisiana House of Representatives)
